name: picklist-scan-return

actions.command: if [ "{{body.action}}" = "scan-return" ]; then doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash ../skills/active/picklist-ops/scan-return.sh "{{body.batch_id}}"; fi

_comment: Fires when a picker scans the QR code on a returned picklist. Payload: {action: 'scan-return', batch_id: 'PL-YYYYMMDD-NNN'}. Fetches and prints shipping labels, updates BaseLinker order statuses.

name: picklist-manual-batch

actions.command: if [ "{{body.action}}" = "manual-batch" ]; then doppler run -p shared-services -c prd -- bash ../skills/active/picklist-ops/manual-batch.sh "{{body.order_ids}}"; fi

_comment: Fires a manual picklist print. Payload: {action: 'manual-batch'} for next 25, or {action: 'manual-batch', order_ids: '125001,125002'} for specific orders.
